• Option 2 "Poster" (a long strip of cloth or paper bearing a slogan or design), Option 3 "Severe" (strict, plain, and without comfort or luxury) and Option 4 "Intimidate" (make someone feel discouraged or apprehensive) are unrelated to the meaning of "derogate".
